$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (notarized Content entry with content_type LIKE 'governance-action:%'). Category A per p2p-design-gate.
title: GovernanceActionContent
description: Wire shape for a governance-action realized as a Content entry on elohim DNA. Parent of child attestation Content entries that cast votes. Source of truth is the Holochain DHT — this schema describes the JSON-on-wire shape only. See spec §4.2.

content_type.description: Discriminator. Subtype must be declared in some pillar manifest's governance-actions section

author_id.description: Proposer's agent CID (signed via Content action header)

metadata_json.description: Serialized JSON conforming to GovernanceActionMetadata (sibling schema)
